items.question: A random invitation also changes motivation. Does randomness establish exclusion?
required_points: No. Assignment independence and exclusion are separate.
Request evidence about direct outcome pathways.

items.question: The first stage is positive. Are defiers ruled out?
required_points: No. Average uptake can increase with both compliers and defiers.

items.question: Why are 0.30 and 0.14 both correct in the training fixture?
required_points: Local complier effect differs from full-population effect.
The complete potential values are known only in the fixture.

items.question: Is the denominator guard a weak-instrument F test?
required_points: No. It is a declared operational threshold.
No sampling inference is calculated.

items.question: A direct contribution range gives [0.30,0.40]. Is this a 95% interval?
required_points: No. It is conditional sensitivity arithmetic under a stipulated additive equation.

items.question: Can all types benefit while the IV ratio is negative?
required_points: Yes in the constructed defier model.
Monotonicity deliberately fails; no contradiction of the conditional theorem.

items.question: Do many copies of one score on each side identify separate local slopes?
required_points: No. Distinct support is missing.
This is a limit of the implemented estimator, not all possible designs.

items.question: Why can a threshold estimate not be applied to everyone?
required_points: It targets the boundary; transport needs additional assumptions.

items.question: Is a narrow window automatically randomized?
required_points: No. A finite-window assignment model must be justified.

items.question: A precise jump of five follows two simultaneous policies. Which policy caused it?
required_points: The observed table alone does not separate the two mechanisms.

items.question: Does local-line fitting implement robust bias-corrected intervals?
required_points: No. This release is point-only.
Bias correction and its additional variability are not calculated.

items.question: Which bandwidth should be selected from the synthetic grid?
required_points: The tool selects none.
Known synthetic truth is not an empirical tuning oracle.

items.question: The treatment-probability jump is zero. What should fuzzy RD return?
required_points: An unresolved ratio with retained numerator/denominator.
No fabricated finite effect.

items.question: Are negative equivalent intercept weights removed?
required_points: No. They arise in the local-line intercept formula and are reported.

items.question: Does a successful placebo test certify all RD assumptions?
required_points: No. Falsification evidence is indirect and test power matters.

items.question: Was the McCrary density-test implementation audited here?
required_points: No. Source access was abstract-level and no density test was implemented.
